prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Explore Companion Paths", "Choose between predefined friendly pets or create a custom companion from your photos.", "Continue to Selection"]
1: ["Signing in syncs and secures your pet across devices automatically."]
2: ["Your account keeps your desktop pet saved safely so you never lose progress."]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Pet", "Answer two quick questions to see which pet best fits your desktop vibe.", "What personality do you prefer?"]
4: ["Photo Upload Requirements", "Ensure clear lighting and a single subject for optimal pet generation."]
5: ["Creating your pet assets. This usually takes under two minutes."]
6: ["While You Wait: Desktop Companion Tips", "Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Click and drag them anywhere or right-click for options.", "I will appear on your screen shortly!"]
7: ["Your Pet Is Ready!", "Check your desktop. Use the taskbar icon or direct clicks to interact.", "Control guide: Left-click to interact, right-click menu to hide or customize."]
8: ["Tip: Right-click the pet tray icon anytime to open commands or hide your desktop pet."]
9: []
